name: Rion
source: A maid who takes care of Natsuyu. Rion is a high-spirited and very loyal (to Natsuyu) person. Although she's the same age as Natsuyu, she was raised as a maid since she was very young, and hasn't had the chance to go to school. Her catchphrase is "I'll [insert action here] with enthusiasm!"
